attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This changes the default SQLite database filename from yessql.db to OrchardCore.db, so existing deployments upgrading in-place will silently start a brand-new empty database unless they explicitly set DatabaseName back to yessql.db, causing apparent data loss for any tenant not aware of this migration note."}

reason: This changes the default SQLite database filename from yessql.db to OrchardCore.db, so existing deployments upgrading in-place will silently start a brand-new empty database unless they explicitly set DatabaseName back to yessql.db, causing apparent data loss for any tenant not aware of this migration note.
